plan.goal: Convert CSV table to point shapefile using X column as longitude and Y column as latitude to create point geometries
plan.notes: Use X column for longitude values and Y column for latitude values. The sample coordinates suggest the data is from Alabama (USA), so assign WGS84 (EPSG:4326) as the CRS since these are decimal degree coordinates. All attribute columns (Rate_per_100000, PopulationDensity, Beer, NoHealthInsurance, Neighbor_Disadvantage) should be carried forward as fields in the output shapefile.
